types.description: LOGO!Power isolated stabilized power supply, 24 V DC / 2.5 A

document.title: Siemens Data sheet 6EP1332-1SH43
document.pages: 1-4; connection inventory and Class II on p.3

modelingNotes: Exact 6EP1332-1SH43 only. Rated input 100-240 V AC, operating range 85-264 V AC at 47-63 Hz, or 110-300 V DC. No input scalar voltage rating is assigned to this dual-mode range. Manual p.24 specifies DC positive to L1 (L in exact datasheet), negative to N.

Output nominal 24 V DC, adjustable 22.2-26.4 V; total rated output 2.5 A / typical 60 W, shared across both positive terminals. Derate 2%/K above +55 through +70 degC; operation -20 to +70 degC with natural convection. Specifications otherwise at rated input and +25 degC. Conditional aggregate current is retained here rather than assigned independently per screw.

Exact datasheet p.3 inventories L and N once each, + and - twice each; no auxiliary connections. Family manual p.10 uses L1 instead of L. Preserve exact-sheet L. +.1/+.2 and -.1/-.2 are authoring aliases for repeated + and - legends, not manufacturer numbers or asserted left/right coordinates.

Manual 06.2014 C98130-A7560-A999-3-7629, pp.9-10,13,24-25: https://www.manualslib.com/manual/1612842/Siemens-Logo-Power-Series.html. Visually reviewed family illustrations pp.9,13,25; p.25 explicitly illustrates a different family member, used only to corroborate shared terminal convention. Exact-order inventory comes from its own datasheet.

Two screws for the single positive output and two for its return establish duplicated same-polarity endpoints (datasheet p.3, manual p.10). Represent factory continuity with explicit project jumpers +.1 to +.2 and -.1 to -.2. This interpretation is supported by the single isolated output shown in manual p.13, not by a detailed internal copper drawing. Never join opposite polarities or primary to secondary.

Class II without protective conductor; no PE, shield, communication or auxiliary terminals. Green OK LED and adjustment potentiometer are local controls, not electrical connections. Manual p.25 requires an external minus-to-PE connection when supplying Class I devices; this conditional field bond is not factory continuity.

L and N are required for operation in either supply mode. No individual output screw is universally required: duplicate takeoffs are alternatives and no-load operation is allowed. Shared output policy permits explicit factory-link representation plus field lead; it does not authorize multiple conductors under a clamp. Functions and symbols never manufacture continuity.

connectionCoverage.notes: Six screw terminals: L, N, two +, two -. Exact-sheet complete connections list and Class II construction support no PE or auxiliary terminals; no shield or communication interfaces. Duplicate suffixes are aliases without physical position assertions. Two explicit factory links required.
